metadata.description: Computer use in the background for Claude Code: your Android phone over ADB, your Windows desktop apps, your real Chrome, a direct line to Codex and Antigravity, your Logitech keypad. Android, Windows and Chrome start their open-source MCP server from PyPI with uvx (pinned and locked with hashes) until each product publishes its native release; Relay connects to its local daemon; Keypad calls NexusKeypad's native helper.

plugins.name: nexus-android
plugins.description: Android phone over plain ADB (no root, no app): screen, gestures, SMS/RCS, notifications, files, settings. Needs uv and USB debugging; adb is downloaded if missing.

plugins.name: nexus-windows
plugins.description: Windows desktop apps through native UI Automation: observe, click, type, menus, shortcuts and launch. Foreground interaction is explicit when required. Windows 10/11, needs uv.

plugins.name: nexus-browser
plugins.description: Your real Chrome (your sessions) driven in background tabs: forms, network, dialogs, cross-origin iframes, exports, downloads. Requires the one-time NexusBrowser install (Chrome extension + local bridge, Windows).

plugins.name: nexus-relay
plugins.description: Direct link between Claude, Codex and Antigravity on one Windows PC: topic rooms, multi-agent review, delegated tasks. Needs the NexusRelay daemon, installed by the one-line install (or NexusRelay's get.ps1).

plugins.name: nexus-keypad
plugins.description: NexusKeypad in Claude: live states for the Logitech keypad (hooks), exact usage (5-hour and weekly) and, under the prompt, whether Codex and Antigravity are reachable through Nexus Relay. No alert, no network. Needs NexusKeypad, installed by NexusSystem (or NexusKeypad's get.ps1).
